texts.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]收到的最后一束信号无异于混乱的静电音。他们一直在研究[From.GetName]上奇怪的区域风暴，并且一直发回令人难以置信的前期报告。这股风暴会对发送过去的探测器做出反应，制造出真空口袋来避开它们，再缓慢地往回渗透进探测器。在我们失去联络之前，[Root.GetName]正计划在风暴处测试许多不同的扫描频率。科研船看上去已经沉没到了气态巨行星深处，现在已经陷入了沉寂。
texts.en: The last signal received from [Root.GetName] was not much more than garbled static. They had been studying the strange localized storms on [From.GetName] and were sending back incredible preliminary reports. The tempest reacted to the probes being sent in, creating vacuum pockets to avoid them and then slowly seeping back in towards the drones. [Root.GetName] was planning on testing out numerous scanning frequencies at the storm before we lost contact. The science ship seems to have sunken into the gas giant and appears to be dormant.

texts.zh: 来自[Root.GetName]的信号突然从主脑意识中被切断了。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]看上去并没有死亡，只是无法与我们交流。们一直在研究[From.GetName]上奇怪的区域风暴，并且一直发回令人难以置信的前期报告。这股风暴会对发送过去的探测器做出反应，制造出真空口袋来避开它们，再缓慢地往回渗透进探测器。在联络被切断之前，[Root.GetName]的计划是在风暴处测试许多不同的扫描频率。科研船看上去已经沉没到了气态巨行星深处，现在已经陷入了沉寂。
texts.en: The signals from [Root.GetName] were suddenly cut off from the consciousness. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] do not appear to be dead, just unable to communicate with us. They had been studying the strange localized storms on [From.GetName] and were sending back incredible preliminary reports. The tempest reacted to the probes being sent in, creating vacuum pockets to avoid them and then slowly seeping back in towards the drones. The plan for [Root.GetName] was to test out numerous scanning frequencies at the storm before contact was cut off. The science ship seems to have sunk into the gas giant and now appears dormant.

label.zh: 等等，现在[From.GetName]的局势更—加—有趣了。
label.en: Wait, [From.GetName] is even MORE interesting now.

texts.zh: 在几个月的工作之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]终于设法调整[FromFrom.GetName]护盾的工作方式，使得[FromFromFrom.GetName]风暴放开了对落难舰船的钳制。同[trapped_in_storm.GetName]的通讯很快重新建立了起来，十分难以置信的是，[FromFrom.GetName]上没有组员记得他们被风暴困住的这段时间。
texts.en: After months of work, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to alternate [FromFrom.GetName] shields in such a way that [FromFromFrom.GetName] tempest released its grip on the marooned ship. Communications with [trapped_in_storm.GetName] was quickly re-established, and incredibly none onboard [FromFrom.GetName] seem to remember their time trapped inside the storm.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]被[FromFrom.GetName]上的风暴围困。他们唯一的希望在于我们发射一艘新飞船过去，然后远距离重调制他们的护盾频率。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] is trapped in a storm on [FromFrom.GetName]. Their only hope may rest in our sending a new ship there, and remotely modulating their shield frequencies.
